Problem: Duplicate charge double charged charged twice same purchase repeated payment charged two times
Resolution Steps: Review the transaction history. Verify whether both charges were completed or one is pending. If a duplicate charge is confirmed, escalate it for correction according to the billing policy.

Problem: Payment not reflected payment missing paid but not showing transaction not updated money deducted payment pending
Resolution Steps: Verify the payment reference and transaction status. Check whether the payment is still processing. If the payment remains unreflected, escalate to the billing team.

Problem: Cancel subscription cancellation terminate membership stop recurring subscription before next month
Resolution Steps: Verify the subscription and cancellation terms. Confirm any applicable notice period or charges. Submit the cancellation request and provide confirmation after it has been processed.

Problem: Device compatibility compatible with iPhone phone laptop product supported devices specifications
Resolution Steps: Identify the exact product model and the device it must work with. Check the official compatibility requirements. Explain supported devices and any limitations.

Problem: Damaged item refund money back broken product defective item received damaged request refund
Resolution Steps: Request the order details and evidence of the damage if required. Check the return and refund policy. Refer the case for refund approval or replacement according to the applicable policy.
Escalation Required: If approval or investigation is required

Problem: Internet disconnection disconnecting connection drops WiFi network keeps disconnecting connectivity issue
Resolution Steps: Check the connection status and whether other devices are affected. Restart the connection or device if appropriate. Check service status and escalate if the problem continues.
Escalation Required: If troubleshooting does not resolve the issue

Problem: Device restarting unexpected restart reboot device keeps restarting on its own
Resolution Steps: Check whether the device displays an error message. Install pending software updates if appropriate. Check for overheating or power issues. If the device continues restarting, refer it to technical support.
Escalation Required: If the device keeps restarting after basic checks

Problem: Cancel booking reservation cancel appointment withdraw booking cancel a booking made yesterday
Resolution Steps: Verify the booking reference and booking status. Check the applicable cancellation policy, deadlines, and any charges. Submit the cancellation request if eligible and provide confirmation after it has been processed.
Escalation Required: If the booking cannot be cancelled or the policy is unclear

Problem: Turn off automatic renewal stop auto renewal disable recurring payment stop plan renewing subscription
Resolution Steps: Verify the customer's subscription and renewal status. Check the applicable terms and renewal deadline. Disable automatic renewal if permitted, then confirm the change and explain when the current subscription ends.
Escalation Required: If automatic renewal cannot be disabled or the status is unclear
